compounddef.title: Thermal Weathering and Talus Erosion Algorithms

detaileddescription.para: This document provides a comprehensive overview of the thermal erosion models implemented in HighMap. Thermal weathering simulates mechanical rock disintegration (freeze-thaw fracturing, gravity-induced scree slides, and scarp retreat) where material collapses when slopes exceed the critical angle of repose (talus slope).
All GPU algorithms are accelerated via OpenCL and defined in thermal_erosion.hpp.
